name: Microsoft SQL Server
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300)
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600, for reporting work)
tools: Azure Data Studio or VS Code mssql extension

beginner.summary: For developers, analysts and junior DBAs new to SQL Server. Covers installation and tools, databases and files, tables and data types, constraints, T-SQL querying, joins, aggregation and window functions, CTEs and APPLY, data changes with MERGE and OUTPUT, views, indexes, transactions and locking, stored procedures, functions and triggers, error handling, security, backups, SQL Server Agent and bulk loading.
prerequisites: Knows what tables, rows and columns are
Comfortable installing software on Windows or Linux
No previous SQL Server experience needed
outcomes: Install SQL Server and work in SSMS
Design tables and write T-SQL queries, procedures and functions
Secure databases with logins, users and roles
Back up, restore and schedule jobs

days.topic: SQL Server Overview, Editions and Installation Setup
subtopics: What SQL Server is and where it is used
Editions: Express, Developer, Standard and Enterprise
SQL Server on Windows, Linux, containers and Azure
Service accounts and the SQL Server services
SQL Server Management Studio and Azure Data Studio
Connecting with Windows and SQL authentication
System databases: master, model, msdb and tempdb
days.lab_task: Install SQL Server on Windows and in a Linux container, connect with SSMS and Azure Data Studio, restore AdventureWorks and record versions, services and system databases.
days.deliverable: Install notes and an instance information sheet
checks: SQL Server 2022 reported for both installs
Purpose of master, model, msdb and tempdb correct
objectives: Install it on Windows and Linux

days.lab_task: Create a database with data and log files on separate drives, add a filegroup for archive tables, set sensible autogrowth and report file sizes and free space.
days.deliverable: CREATE DATABASE script and a space report
checks: Used and free space per file

subtopics: Choosing types for storage and correctness
days.lab_task: Create sales and HR schemas with tables using correct types, compare storage of varchar and nvarchar, add identity keys and a computed column for line totals.
days.deliverable: DDL script and type choice notes
checks: Insert a non-ASCII name into varchar and nvarchar
nvarchar keeps it and varchar loses characters

days.lab_task: Add keys, foreign keys with suitable delete rules, unique emails and checks on quantities and dates, then test each with bad data and draw the database diagram.
days.deliverable: Constraint script, test results and diagram
checks: Insert an order for a missing customer

days.topic: Querying with T-SQL: SELECT, Filtering and Sorting
subtopics: NULL handling with ISNULL and COALESCE
ORDER BY, TOP and OFFSET FETCH
Built-in string, date and conversion functions
days.lab_task: Answer ten questions on AdventureWorks, including paged product lists with OFFSET FETCH, customers without phone numbers and orders labelled by size with CASE.
days.deliverable: Query file and results
checks: TRY_CONVERT returns NULL for bad values

days.lab_task: Report orders with customer, product and salesperson, list products never sold, show employees with their managers and fix a join that doubles revenue.
days.deliverable: Query file and a note on the doubling bug
checks: Each employee with the right manager

subtopics: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX
days.lab_task: Report sales by year and territory with ROLLUP subtotals, rank salespeople within territories, calculate running totals and month-over-month change, and list products per order with STRING_AGG.
days.deliverable: Query file and results

days.lab_task: Walk the employee hierarchy with a recursive CTE, get the latest three orders per customer with CROSS APPLY and rewrite a nested query as a chain of CTEs.
days.deliverable: Query file and results
checks: CTE version returns the same rows

days.topic: Changing Data: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE and OUTPUT
days.lab_task: Load a staging price list, update prices with a join, upsert products with MERGE, capture every change with OUTPUT into an audit table and test changes inside a transaction before committing.
days.deliverable: DML script and audit table output

days.lab_task: Create a reporting view over sales, give a reporting user access to the view only, add WITH CHECK OPTION to an updatable view and create an indexed view for a daily total.
days.deliverable: View definitions and access tests
checks: Query the base table as the reporting user
Update through the view outside its filter

subtopics: Missing index suggestions and their limits
days.lab_task: Load a million orders, time three slow queries, read their plans, add indexes with included columns and compare plans and logical reads afterwards.
days.deliverable: Before and after plans and statistics
checks: Each hint accepted or rejected with a reason

days.lab_task: Create blocking between two sessions, find the blocker with DMVs and sp_WhoIsActive, show dirty reads with NOLOCK and fix a long transaction.
days.deliverable: Session transcripts and DMV output
checks: Blocking session and its query found
Read with NOLOCK during an update
Set XACT_ABORT ON and fail a statement

days.lab_task: Write procedures to place an order and search products with optional filters using safe dynamic SQL, grant execute only and show how string-built SQL is open to injection.
days.deliverable: Procedure code and injection demonstration
checks: Order and lines created and the new ID returned
Call as a user with execute only

days.lab_task: Write an inline table-valued function for customer orders, compare a scalar function with an inline version for speed, and add an audit trigger that handles multi-row updates.
days.deliverable: Function and trigger code and timings

days.lab_task: Add TRY CATCH to the order procedure with transaction handling, error logging and a retry for deadlocks, then force each error path.
days.deliverable: Procedure code and error log output
checks: Transaction rolled back and the error logged

days.lab_task: Create an application login with execute-only rights on the sales schema, a read-only reporting role, fix an orphaned user after a restore and audit who has sysadmin.
days.deliverable: Security script and test results
checks: Select from a table as the application

subtopics: Recovery models: simple, full and bulk-logged
Restoring to a point in time
Backing up to URL in Azure
days.lab_task: Set the full recovery model, take full, differential and log backups, delete data by mistake and restore to one minute before the delete.
days.deliverable: Backup scripts and restore evidence
checks: Restore to a point in time
objectives: Restore to a point in time

days.lab_task: Schedule nightly backups and an index maintenance job, email an operator on failure through Database Mail and alert on severity 17 and above errors.
days.deliverable: Job scripts, alert settings and test emails

days.lab_task: Load a 2-million-row CSV with BULK INSERT into a staging table, clean and move it, export a report with bcp and compare load times with and without minimal logging.
days.deliverable: Load scripts, export file and timing table

days.lab_task: Build an order database with constraints, indexes, views, procedures with error handling, audit triggers, roles, scheduled backups and a restore test, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Scripts, job definitions, restore evidence and demo recording
checks: Run the order procedure under bad input
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one database

intermediate.summary: For DBAs and developers who run SQL Server. Covers execution plans, index tuning and columnstore, statistics, Query Store, isolation levels and RCSI, deadlocks, tempdb, instance configuration, wait statistics, Extended Events, backup strategy, Always On availability groups, log shipping and failover cluster instances, encryption and auditing, partitioning, SSIS, maintenance automation with dbatools and Azure SQL.
prerequisites: Writes T-SQL procedures and queries with joins and windows
outcomes: Tune queries, indexes and configuration using plans, waits and Query Store
Run high availability with availability groups and log shipping
Secure data with TDE, Always Encrypted and auditing
Automate maintenance and run databases on Azure SQL

subtopics: Operators: seeks, scans, lookups, joins and sorts
Plan Explorer and SSMS plan comparison
days.lab_task: Read the actual plans of five slow queries, find the costliest operators, a bad estimate, a spill to tempdb and an implicit conversion, and fix each.
days.deliverable: Annotated plans and fixes
checks: Spill warning found and memory grant explained
Type mismatch fixed and seek used

days.topic: Index Tuning, Filtered Indexes and Columnstore
days.lab_task: Review indexes with DMVs and sp_BlitzIndex, drop unused and duplicate indexes, add a filtered index for open orders and a columnstore index for reporting, and measure the effect.
days.deliverable: Index review, changes and measurements
checks: Batch mode on columnstore and lower CPU

days.lab_task: Show a bad plan from stale statistics, update them, compare estimates under two compatibility levels and add filtered statistics for a skewed column.
days.deliverable: Statistics output, plans and notes
checks: Estimates differ and the cause is explained

days.lab_task: Enable Query Store, cause a plan regression, find it in the regressed queries report, force the good plan and turn on automatic plan correction.
days.deliverable: Query Store settings, reports and forced plan

days.topic: Isolation Levels, Row Versioning and RCSI
days.lab_task: Show readers blocked by writers, turn on RCSI and show the blocking gone, cause an update conflict under snapshot isolation and add rowversion checks to an application update.
days.deliverable: Session transcripts and settings

subtopics: Capturing deadlocks with the system_health session
days.lab_task: Reproduce three deadlock types, read each graph from system_health, fix two by changing access order and indexes and add retry for the third.
days.deliverable: Deadlock graphs and fixes
checks: Deadlock no longer occurs under load
Fewer deadlocks per hour after fixes

subtopics: Number and size of data files
days.lab_task: Create tempdb allocation contention under load, fix it with more equally sized files and memory-optimised metadata, and find the sessions using the most tempdb.
days.deliverable: Configuration changes and contention measurements

days.topic: Instance Configuration: Memory, MAXDOP and Cost Threshold
days.lab_task: Review an instance with sp_Blitz, set memory, MAXDOP and cost threshold for its hardware, turn on instant file initialisation and record the reasons for each change.
days.deliverable: sp_Blitz output before and after and a change log
checks: Value leaves memory for the OS

subtopics: Common waits: CXPACKET, PAGEIOLATCH, LCK and WRITELOG
days.lab_task: Collect wait statistics during four workloads, name the top waits for each, link them to their causes and fix the top cause for one.
days.deliverable: Wait analysis and fix
checks: PAGEIOLATCH waits linked to missing indexes

days.topic: Extended Events for Monitoring and Troubleshooting
subtopics: Ring buffer and event file targets
days.lab_task: Create sessions that capture queries over one second and errors above severity 16, filter to one database, read the files and find the worst query.
days.deliverable: Session definitions and findings

subtopics: Backup schedules for RPO and RTO
days.lab_task: Design a backup schedule for three databases with different targets, take a tail-log backup after a failure, run a piecemeal restore of one filegroup and check integrity with CHECKDB.
days.deliverable: Backup design, restore logs and CHECKDB output
checks: No errors on the restored database

subtopics: Monitoring with the dashboard and DMVs
days.lab_task: Build a two-replica availability group with a listener, seed a database automatically, run reports on the secondary, fail over manually and measure data movement lag.
days.deliverable: Configuration, failover log and lag measurements
checks: Applications reconnect to the new primary

days.topic: Log Shipping and Failover Cluster Instances
days.lab_task: Set up log shipping to a DR server with a delayed restore, recover a dropped table from it and write a comparison of log shipping, FCIs and availability groups.
days.deliverable: Log shipping configuration, recovery evidence and comparison
checks: Table copied from the delayed secondary

days.lab_task: Turn on TDE and back up its certificate, protect card numbers with Always Encrypted, mask emails for support staff, limit sales staff to their region with RLS and audit access to salaries.
days.deliverable: Security configuration and tests
checks: Restore the TDE database elsewhere without the certificate

subtopics: Sliding window with SWITCH, SPLIT and MERGE
days.lab_task: Partition a 100-million-row sales table by month, show partition elimination, run a monthly sliding window that switches out the oldest month and truncate a partition.
days.deliverable: Partition scripts, plans and window job
checks: Done in seconds with metadata only

days.topic: ETL with SQL Server Integration Services
subtopics: Logging and running packages from Agent
days.lab_task: Build an SSIS package that loads daily CSV sales into a warehouse with lookups, error rows to a reject table and environment parameters, deploy it to the catalog and schedule it.
days.deliverable: SSIS project, catalog deployment and run reports

days.topic: Reporting with SQL Server Reporting Services
subtopics: SSRS and Power BI Report Server
tools: SSRS or Power BI Report Server
days.lab_task: Build a paginated sales report with cascading year and territory parameters, grouped totals and drill-down, schedule an email subscription and restrict it to the sales group.
days.deliverable: Report definition, subscription and access tests
checks: Territory list limited to that year

days.topic: Automating Maintenance with dbatools and Ola Hallengren
days.lab_task: Install Ola Hallengren jobs on three instances, use dbatools to check last backups and CHECKDB across them, test restores automatically and copy logins between instances.
days.deliverable: Jobs, PowerShell scripts and reports
checks: Last backup per database across instances
Logins with passwords and SIDs copied

days.topic: Azure SQL Database and Managed Instance
subtopics: Azure SQL options: Database, Managed Instance and SQL Server on VMs
What DBAs still own in Azure SQL
Migrating with Azure Database Migration Service
days.lab_task: Create an Azure SQL database with Entra login, restore to a point in time, add a failover group in another region and fail over, then migrate a small database to Managed Instance.
days.deliverable: Configuration, failover evidence and migration log
checks: Data and logins on Managed Instance

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Highly Available and Tuned SQL Server
days.lab_task: Take over a slow, unprotected sales system: build an availability group, a backup strategy with restore tests, tune top queries with Query Store and waits, encrypt and audit data and present results with a failover demo.
days.deliverable: Configuration, tuning log, restore evidence and presentation
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one system

advanced.summary: For senior DBAs and database architects. Covers storage engine internals, advanced query tuning, concurrency at scale and In-Memory OLTP, columnstore analytics, availability group architecture, disaster recovery, a performance method, licensing and consolidation, upgrades and migrations, SQL Server on Linux and Kubernetes, hardening and ledger, HA monitoring, CDC and replication, database DevOps, Azure Arc, Fabric mirroring, vector search, very large databases and production incidents.
prerequisites: Runs SQL Server in production with availability groups
Tunes queries with plans, waits and Query Store
outcomes: Diagnose deep performance and concurrency problems
Design availability, recovery and hybrid platforms
Upgrade, migrate and deliver database changes safely
Run large and secure SQL Server estates cost-effectively

days.lab_task: Inspect data and index pages with DBCC PAGE, read log records for an update, fix a log with too many VLFs and watch ghost cleanup after deletes.
days.deliverable: Annotated internals notes
checks: Update operation found in the log

days.topic: Advanced Query Tuning: Parameter Sniffing and Intelligent Query Processing
days.lab_task: Reproduce parameter sniffing on a skewed procedure, compare fixes, test parameter-sensitive plans in compatibility level 160 and fix a row goal problem.
days.deliverable: Plans, timings and recommendation
checks: Different parameters give very different times

days.topic: Concurrency at Scale: Latches, Hot Pages and In-Memory OLTP
subtopics: When In-Memory OLTP is worth it
days.lab_task: Create last-page insert contention with ostress, fix it with OPTIMIZE_FOR_SEQUENTIAL_KEY and with a memory-optimised table, and compare throughput.
days.deliverable: Contention measurements and comparison
checks: Higher throughput than the interpreted version

days.lab_task: Build a columnstore fact table, check rowgroup quality, add ordering for segment elimination, run operational analytics on a live table and plan maintenance.
days.deliverable: Columnstore design, DMV output and timings
checks: Few open or small rowgroups after the load
Segments skipped for a date filter
Run analytics on the live table
OLTP throughput kept within the target

days.topic: Availability Group Architecture: Distributed and Contained AGs
days.lab_task: Build a multi-subnet availability group, link it to another region with a distributed availability group, add a contained availability group for logins and jobs and patch replicas with rolling failovers.
days.deliverable: Architecture, configuration and patching log
checks: Create a login in the contained AG

days.lab_task: Write DR plans for three systems, store immutable backup copies, run a regional DR drill with timing and failback, and recover a database after a simulated ransomware attack.
days.deliverable: DR plans, drill report and recovery evidence

days.topic: A Performance Troubleshooting Method at Scale
subtopics: Top-down method: waits, queries and resources
days.lab_task: Use a baseline and the First Responder Kit to diagnose a slowdown across three instances, prioritise five fixes by impact and present the findings.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis, priority list and presentation
checks: Cause and plan clear to managers

subtopics: Core-based and server plus CAL licensing
Licensing in virtual machines and containers
days.lab_task: Inventory a sample estate, design a consolidation onto fewer licensed hosts, apply Hybrid Benefit for Azure workloads and estimate savings.
days.deliverable: Inventory, consolidation design and savings estimate

subtopics: Data Migration Assistant and Azure Migrate
Migrating to Azure SQL Managed Instance with the link feature
days.lab_task: Assess a SQL Server 2016 database, upgrade it side by side to 2022 with Query Store protecting plans, and migrate another database to Managed Instance with the link feature.
days.deliverable: Assessment, upgrade log and migration evidence

days.topic: SQL Server on Linux, Containers and Kubernetes
subtopics: Availability groups on Kubernetes with operators
When to run SQL Server in containers
days.lab_task: Install SQL Server on Linux and configure it with mssql-conf, run it in Kubernetes with persistent storage, kill the pod and confirm data survives.
days.deliverable: Configuration, manifests and test results
checks: Data kept on the persistent volume

days.lab_task: Harden an instance against a baseline, run vulnerability assessment, create a ledger table and prove tampering is detected, and assemble compliance evidence.
days.deliverable: Hardening report, assessment results and evidence pack

days.topic: Monitoring High Availability and Estate Health
subtopics: What to monitor for availability groups
Monitoring tools: Redgate, SolarWinds and open source
days.lab_task: Build dashboards for availability group health and estate capacity, alert on redo queue size and suspended data movement with runbooks, and trigger each alert.
days.deliverable: Dashboards, alert rules and runbooks
checks: Alert fires with a runbook link
Alert fires before the threshold matters

days.topic: Change Data Capture, Change Tracking and Replication
subtopics: Merge and peer-to-peer replication in brief
Streaming changes to Kafka with Debezium
days.lab_task: Feed order changes to a reporting server with transactional replication and to Kafka with CDC and Debezium, compare latency and load and write a choice guide.
days.deliverable: Configuration, latency measurements and guide
checks: Method recommended for each use case

days.topic: Database DevOps: SSDT, DACPACs, tSQLt and Pipelines
subtopics: Pipelines with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
days.lab_task: Put the order database in a SQL project with tSQLt tests, build and test it in a pipeline, publish a DACPAC to test and produce a deployment report for production approval.
days.deliverable: Project, tests, pipeline and deployment report

days.lab_task: Connect on-premises instances to Azure Arc, run the best practices assessment, enable Defender and Entra login and view the estate in Azure.
days.deliverable: Arc configuration, assessment results and screenshots
checks: Log in with Entra ID on-premises

days.topic: Microsoft Fabric Mirroring and Analytics Integration
subtopics: Fabric mirroring for SQL Server and Azure SQL
Reporting in Power BI on mirrored data
days.lab_task: Mirror the order database to Fabric, query it with the SQL analytics endpoint, build a Power BI report on it and measure delay from commit to report.
days.deliverable: Mirroring configuration, queries, report and latency notes
checks: Only permitted users read mirrored data

days.topic: Vector Search and AI Features in SQL Server 2025
subtopics: Embeddings from Azure OpenAI or local models
tools: SQL Server 2025 or Azure SQL Database
days.lab_task: Store product description embeddings in a vector column, run similarity search with filters, combine with full-text ranking and build a small RAG query for product questions.
days.deliverable: Schema, queries and RAG prototype
checks: Compare with and without the vector index

subtopics: What makes a database very large
Moving large data with minimal downtime
days.lab_task: Plan operations for a 20 TB database: striped backups, CHECKDB spread across nights, partition-level index maintenance and an archive process, and test them on a scaled sample.
days.deliverable: Operations plan and test results
objectives: Back up and check at scale

subtopics: An incident method for SQL Server
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected incidents (CPU from a plan regression, a blocking storm, a full log from an open transaction, a suspended AG replica and page corruption), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Cause found and log space reused

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise SQL Server Platform
days.lab_task: Design and deliver a SQL Server platform for a payments system: distributed availability groups, immutable backups, tuned workloads, database DevOps, hardening, Arc management and cost controls, then run a game day with failover, ransomware recovery and a release.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, automation, game day report and review presentation
checks: Tested and deployed through the pipeline
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
Run SQL Server at enterprise standard
